full_details: At breakfast the board was threepence and the fish was the fast. The loaf was still a penny and a finger short. Mistress Ansell said two houses alike is no plot. You did not tell her who wants what, and you did not say a name. Anne's sheet stayed in the chest. You did not find a sum in it, because you did not open it. In the afternoon the Verona page was as you had left it, the days still blank, and no speech under the plan. You looked at the friar's name and wrote nothing under it.
one_sentence: You paid threepence for fish and left Anne's sheet in the chest.
title: Paid threepence and left Anne's sheet in the chest
